GripRecord.title: Grip Strength Record
GripRecord.description: A single record of left and right hand grip strength along with fatigue level.

uid.description: The user ID of the owner.

date.description: The date of the record (MM-DD format).

time.description: The time of the record (HH:MM format).

left.description: Left hand grip strength in kg. Can be null/omitted.

right.description: Right hand grip strength in kg. Can be null/omitted.

users/{userId}/records/{recordId}.description: Grip strength records for a specific user.
